task: Separate supervised value-source repair from continuous-policy repair; no Bayesian or old recovery network
evidence_reuse: All 38 roots/5900 branches/checkpoints unchanged; three unresolved failures paused. Existing prefix outcomes are reused, not resimulated as new evidence.

B_evidence.purpose: Reconstruct scoring along saved contact-free progress witnesses; separate mask interruption, smoothing feasibility, raw value preference and nominal reversal. No new full-prefix outcome experiment.

A_training.collection: Frozen nominal checkpoint, original raw training scorer from recovery-duration/run.py:score, no deployment filtering or smoothing, epsilon exploration
A_training.epsilon: 0.30 + (0.05-0.30)*ordinal/95, frozen checkpoint throughout; controlled recollection, not restoration of historical replay
A_training.observations: Same legal current token windows, no goals of humans, no privileged future at inference. Privileged tape is environment evolution only.
A_training.control: Actual complete MC return of each collected epsilon behavior episode at the captured state
A_training.treatment: Same captured state, history, previous executed action and remaining time; complete continuation return of original frozen deployment GRU
A_training.labels: V(s) labels, not Q labels; current-state MC includes the next executed reward. No Bellman division for current-state supervision.
A_training.initialization: Both full networks start from the same frozen nominal state_dict
A_training.split: cases2000..2011 fitting; 2012..2015 validation, whole numerical case held out across scenes
A_training.matching: Identical batch indices, initialization, optimizer state, update count, inputs, dropout RNG per update; label source only differs. Same six-scene coverage in both; compared with historical Parent, recollection and coverage differ, so only trained-arm contrast isolates source.
A_training.stop: Nonfinite gradients, label/restore mismatch or contract failure stops training. No tuning; full closed-loop evaluation required whether loss improves or not.

B_prototypes.gate: Saved safe-prefix decisions are feasible under unchanged smoothing and margin but repeatedly lose to nominal V at >=2 trap cases
B_prototypes.shared_trigger: At least 8 consecutive nominal decisions with nonpositive goal progress, and goal distance has not decreased across last8 executed steps
B_prototypes.commit8: Then choose maximum goal-progress action within the unchanged deployment-safe action set for 8 steps, safety checked each step; return to GRU. Ordinary fixed-duration simple baseline, not novelty.
B_prototypes.adaptive: Same trigger/actions; retain progress-directed control until at least0.5m net goal progress and nominal next progress>=0.02m, or16 steps. Immediate return on native empty-safe-set. Bounded hysteresis reference, not assumed novel.
B_prototypes.progress: Always choose maximum goal-progress safe native candidate; strongest geometry-only explanation. Same smoothing/filters/fallback as Parent.
B_prototypes.stop: No sweeping trigger/duration/progress thresholds. Failure activates no second B version.

evaluation.diagnostic_roots: All existing38, but exclude3 unresolved from new intervention rollouts; reuse nominal existingA outcomes. Separately report10 ranking failures,4 traps and successful controls.
evaluation.fresh_rules: 120 complete native episodes per arm, fixed before any new outcomes. All arms frozen before fresh evaluation. No selection, parameter tuning or rerun to improve results.
evaluation.statistical_unit: Whole numerical case resampled jointly across scenes; paired whole episodes, never candidate/step independence
evaluation.A_go: Deploy-MC improves held-out ranking and closed-loop safe success relative to behavior-MC and nominal without contact regression. Otherwise source-only repair is rejected; do not infer representation failure.
evaluation.B_go: Adaptive safe closed-loop success exceeds both commit8 and progress, without collision/contact regression or damaged success excess. Otherwise no independent adaptive mechanism benefit.
evaluation.science_scope: Controlled reproduction and repair feasibility only. Existing methods and simple hysteresis are not automatically algorithm innovation; frozen-old-policy labels are not claimed to be new-policy exact values.

conditional_A_disambiguation.gate: Source-only repair does not correct the held-outA roots and full closed-loop failure
conditional_A_disambiguation.test: Reuse existing true-successor windows and deployment labels from the2950-action catalogue. Whole-case even/odd split, same targets/updates/batches/init; frozen-encoder head-only vs full-network fitting to test representation correctability on targeted coverage. Do not rerun old ridge results.
conditional_A_disambiguation.interpretation: Head success supports reusable frozen features; full-only success supports trainable representation/optimization limitation; neither success leaves raw information vs sample coverage unresolved. No failure is called proof of insufficient input.
